text:
jasmin-cs: heads up — VanguardRx demo tomorrow 09:00 PT. During pilot they saturated our us-west edge and APAC got ~300ms p95. They asked for a short regional bump + partner CIDR for analytics vendor. Renewal in 21 days, finance flagged SLA concerns.
eric-ops: ok we can open a temp window. need CIDRs and expected qps. also which regions?
jasmin-cs: Customer gave `45.77.12.8/32`, partner `45.80.0.0/22`. expecting bursts up to 1500 qps for 20-40m, normal steady 200 qps. Regions: us-west-2, ap-northeast-1.
noah-net: Recommend allowlist AL-VG-09 + rate policy TEMP_BURST_6H capped 2000 qps with burst window 30m. TTL 6h auto-revoke. We'll pin to those regions and pre-warm KV caches. Need sec sign-off for partner cidr.
sasha-sec: we'll need signed AUP + an infra contact. Can we require partner to use TLS mTLS? If partner is third-party vendor require mTLS and ephemeral token. Also log retention note to ticket.
kai-ae: I'll let the account team know and prep an exec summary. If renewal is in 3 weeks we should get a successful demo or escalate.
jasmin-cs: Vanguard infra contact is rachel@vanguardrx. She confirmed partner is 'DataPulse Analytics'. They said vendor uses TLS only (not mTLS) — security said that's borderline.
eric-ops: plan command:
```
POST /admin/allowlists
{"name":"AL-VG-09","cidrs":["45.77.12.8/32","45.80.0.0/22"],"ttl":"6h","auto_revoke":true}
POST /policies/rate
{"name":"TEMP_BURST_6H","max_qps":2000,"burst_window_sec":1800,"regions":["us-west-2","ap-northeast-1"]}
```
noah-net: after deploy I'll run `redis-cli --rpush kv:prefixes "vanguard:"` to warm caches.
infra-bot: allowlist AL-VG-09 scheduled by eric-ops at 2026-04-10T16:00:00Z
sasha-sec: I approve AL-VG-09 only if DataPulse rotates TLS certs and signs AUP. I'll sign off in ticket CS-10421 once docs are attached.
jasmin-cs: applied and monitoring now. initial spikes hit 1200 qps, p95 latency dropped from 320ms -> 85ms in us-west. ap-northeast still a bit high 220ms p95; Noah can you check upstream routing?
noah-net: digging — looks like vendor server is routing via SIN -> JP. I'll request a traceroute from vendor. Also kicking KV warming in ap-northeast.
eric-ops: vendor asked for an extra 2h extension for partner CIDR to complete analytics run. sasha-sec any objection? we'll set manual revoke.
sasha-sec: ok for 2h extension with manual approval and audit log. ensure token scope limited.
jasmin-cs: demo wrapped — execs happy. Renewal moved to green/monitor. I'll send short feedback survey and log NPS. Thanks team!
kai-ae: scheduling 1-week postmortem + checkin. Nice work :)
